requirement.statement: The Domain Operation contracts, depa ORM domain runtime, and Domain Operation server SHALL be independently consumable through stable package-root identities with generated JavaScript and type declarations, minimal pack artifacts, non-workspace production dependencies, and no source copy, deep import, or machine-absolute dependency.

case.given: clean builds of the three public packages
case.then: the tarball SHALL expose only the package root runtime/types and required metadata, with no tests, demo data, workspace protocol, or private application files

case.given: an independent Bun workspace and the three package tarballs
case.when: dependencies are installed by relative file package identity and the fixture is typechecked
case.then: all imports SHALL resolve from package roots without source copy, deep imports, or absolute paths

requirement.statement: The public Domain Operation server SHALL accept trusted bundle registrations explicitly, expose catalog, operation, preset, and execute HTTP behavior, preserve per-execution runtime ownership, and remain independent of demo databases, Kon, reference bundles, and all concrete business domains.

case.given: an external consumer-owned neutral bundle registration
case.when: the consumer fetches its catalog and complete preset then posts that preset
case.then: the server SHALL route to exactly that bundle and return the public runtime response without business-specific fallback

case.given: the public server package source and artifact
case.when: imports and packed files are inspected
case.then: they SHALL contain no web-server, web-shared, domain-context-bundle, demo/Kon, Holon, organization, or work-dispatch dependency

case.given: a successful external fixture install and lockfile
case.when: node_modules is removed and a frozen reinstall is run
case.then: the same typecheck and runtime smoke SHALL pass
